host_baseline.basis: measured once with the pinned host and a role's structured-output tool (athena.toml [agents]); not measured per invocation

input.basis: Claude Code result.modelUsage for the requested model

output.basis: Claude Code result.modelUsage for the requested model

cache_read.basis: Claude Code result.modelUsage for the requested model

cache_write.basis: Claude Code result.modelUsage for the requested model

cost.basis: Claude Code total_cost_usd, at list price

commands_run: cargo fmt --all && cargo test -p athena-core store 2>&1; cargo test -p athena-cli --test status_role_need 2>&1
cargo fmt --all && cargo test -p athena-cli --test status_role_need 2>&1
cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings 2>&1; cargo test -p xtask --test policy 2>&1; cargo test -p athena-cli --test mirrors 2>&1

policy_denials.detail: git status --short && ls crates/athena-core/src | head -80 && grep -n "role_need\|OLY-9-11" -r crates docs CHANGELOG.md xtask | head -20 && wc -l crates/athena-core/src/store.rs crates/athena-core/src/status.rs

cargo fmt --all && cargo test -p athena-core store 2>&1 | grep -E "^test |test result|error|panicked" ; cargo test -p athena-cli --test status_role_need 2>&1 | grep -E "^test |test result|error|panicked|-->|assert"
cargo fmt --all && cargo test -p athena-core store 2>&1 | rg -v "Compiling" ; cargo test -p athena-cli --test status_role_need 2>&1 | rg -v Compiling
cargo fmt --all && cargo test -p athena-cli --test status_role_need 2>&1 | head -c 3000
cargo test --locked 2>&1 | rg -n "FAILED|failed|panicked|test result: F" ; echo done
cargo fmt --all --check && cargo test --locked --no-fail-fast --quiet 2>&1 | rg "FAILED|panicked|test result: F"
